summary: R-1 method on the Mac VM rig. Long history: a fresh device joined the papercusp pot (log 5b00878b, 7,798,537 merged ops) on papercusp-staging 14d91e00e7c5 and converged +27:02 after join_started, well under the 1 h bound. All 39 papercusp logs read live at +28:25, and at +1:07 no merge cursor had an apply_failure. Short history: a member-link join of hello-world-3-pot (251,059 ops, 463 snapshot rows) on b09cfebff815 converged 5.2 s after join_start. The unit layer of R-1 (log-snapshot.test.ts, read-merge-snapshot-lanes.test.ts) passed in testing:run group 4717f51e-a044-431c-a08c-a967cb039f60, bound separately. NOT CONSTRUCTED: the falsifier's discriminating case, a pot with a LONGER op history but a SMALLER snapshot set; both pots measured here differ in both dimensions. Plan Decisions: D-044 (run #16), D-043 (W2b), D-027/D-036/D-038 (earlier long-history runs +27:55, +26:45, +27:08).
